title: Acceptance evaluator reuse can decline a named root through a macOS directory alias
outcome: An eligible settled evaluator remains reusable when the current macOS named-root path and persisted evaluator cwd are public and private spellings of the same worktree. Reuse continues to reject actual workspace changes.
acceptance: A behavioral macOS test names a worktree under a supported public/private directory alias and shows that an otherwise eligible evaluator reuses the existing child on the next independent request.
A different worktree still fails the existing reuse scope check.
